title: LibreTrendLatest.glucoseLevelRaw is zero
symptom: On newly connected Libre 1 with miao miao 2, error logs appear and xdrip hangs on initial data collection. The Libre itself works fine as glucose level can be read in Libre link app.
fix: Disable the libre trend: xDrip+ Display Settings > Graph Settings > Show libre trend.
evidence_quote: xDrip+ Display Settings > Graph Settings > Show libre trend. Thx!
